about: Flaky tests skipped on CI: each a flake id, its owner lane and an expiry at most 24 h on, at most 3 at once. scripts/quarantine.mjs --add writes an entry and prints the test's skip; --check (and scripts/quarantine.test.mjs, on every pull request) fails once one expires.

tests.name: twenty follow-ups on the pinned OpenCode, every drive's process on the SAME port (as where 4096 is free: OpenCode takes it each time): every event stream opens at the first try
tests.why: Red twice on PRs that don't touch OpenCode, 11-05: merge-queue run 41950713827 (pi-1-2 1.2.0, 5) and #1611's run 41955893370 (pi-1-2 1.2.0, 1), at :182. tl-jobs (opencode-3) diagnoses test timing vs a real port-reuse race, then fixes it.

tests.name: the default image is built on first use, once, from a private context directory holding the recipe alone, removed after; tagged with the recipe's hash and labelled with it; present with that hash, it is ready with no build
tests.why: 'Unexpected end of JSON input' on PRs that don't touch box images, 11-05: #1607 on two legs (~00:58Z, before #1675 merged) and #1673 (run 42005614516, test 22.19.0 any-5). Reads like a JSON read of a file still being written (F31's class). tl-places diagnoses, then fixes.
